scenarios.title: A｜发现多收费
scenarios.setting: 在“退房时账单有问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“发现多收费”。

turns.text: Here’s your final bill. Your total comes to $536.

turns.prompt: 你想提出对账单金额的疑问，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, I think I’ve been charged too much.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think I’ve been charged too much.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I think there’s an extra charge on the bill.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think there’s an extra charge on the bill.
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: The total seems higher than I expected. Could we check it?

feedback.naturalExpression: The total seems higher than I expected. Could we check it?
feedback.explanation: “than I expected”把实际结果与自己的预期作比较，能清楚说明差异。

choices.text: I don’t think this amount is correct.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think this amount is correct.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: You charged me too many money.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think I’ve been charged too much.
feedback.explanation: “money”不可数，询问金额用“how much”，表示金额过多用“too much”，不搭配“many”。

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I was charged for four nights, but I only stayed for three.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was charged for four nights, but I only stayed for three.
feedback.explanation: “was charged”表示被收取费用，用来报告账单结果而不先指责某个人。

choices.text: There’s an extra $50 charge here that I wasn’t expecting.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s an extra $50 charge here that I wasn’t expecting.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: I think I’ve been charged twice for the same service.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’ve been charged twice for the same service.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: The room rate should have been $120 per night, not $140.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room rate should have been $120 per night, not $140.
feedback.explanation: “should have”谈过去时可表示本该这样做，适合反思或承认疏忽。

turns.prompt: 你想出示预订记录，帮助核对原定房价，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. My confirmation shows the original rate here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. My confirmation shows the original rate here.
feedback.explanation: “original”指原件或原始版本；与复印件、修改版区分。

choices.text: Could you compare it with my booking confirmation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you compare it with my booking confirmation?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I’d appreciate it if you could double-check the total.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate it if you could double-check the total.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

turns.text: You’re right. One extra night was added by mistake.

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店在付款前纠正账单，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you correct the bill before I pay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you correct the bill before I pay?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Great. Could you remove that charge, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you remove that charge, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Thank you. Could I see the updated total?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could I see the updated total?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

scenarios.title: B｜发现不认识的消费
scenarios.setting: 在“退房时账单有问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“发现不认识的消费”。

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I don’t recognize this charge on my bill.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t recognize this charge on my bill.
feedback.explanation: “don’t recognize”表示认不出或没有印象，适合先核查陌生记录，而不急于断言有错。

choices.text: Could you tell me what this $35 charge is for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me what this $35 charge is for?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I don’t remember making this purchase.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t remember making this purchase.
feedback.explanation: “I don't remember”表达自己没有印象，并不直接断言这件事从未发生。

choices.text: There’s a charge here that I don’t think belongs to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a charge here that I don’t think belongs to me.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I don’t know this money.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t recognize this charge on my bill.
feedback.explanation: 不认识某笔收费用“I don’t recognize this charge”；“don’t know this money”没有指出账单记录。

turns.text: That charge is listed as minibar usage from last night.

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I didn’t take anything from the minibar.

feedback.naturalExpression: I didn’t take anything from the minibar.
feedback.explanation: “minibar”指客房小冰箱或迷你吧，其中的饮品可能另行计费。

choices.text: I don’t think that charge is mine.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think that charge is mine.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Could you check when it was added to the room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check when it was added to the room?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Are you sure it was charged to room 806?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you sure it was charged to room 806?
feedback.explanation: “was charged”表示被收取费用，用来报告账单结果而不先指责某个人。

turns.prompt: 你想核实陌生消费是否被误记到自己房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could it have been charged to my room by mistake?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could it have been charged to my room by mistake?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Is there a record of what was supposedly taken?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a record of what was supposedly taken?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could you check whether another room number was entered incorrectly?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether another room number was entered incorrectly?
feedback.explanation: “room number”指房间号，用来定位住客或送物地点。

turns.text: You’re right. It belongs to room 608, not 806.

turns.prompt: 你想请对方核对收费或价格，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for checking. Could you remove it from my bill?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for checking. Could you remove it from my bill?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Great. Could I see the corrected bill, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could I see the corrected bill, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

scenarios.title: C｜与酒店核实费用
scenarios.setting: 在“退房时账单有问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“与酒店核实费用”。

turns.prompt: 你想在付款前核对不清楚的收费项目，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you explain some of the charges on my bill?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain some of the charges on my bill?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to go over the bill before I pay.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to go over the bill before I pay.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could you help me understand what these fees are for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me understand what these fees are for?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I just want to make sure I understand the total.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just want to make sure I understand the total.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.text: Of course. Which charge would you like me to explain?

turns.prompt: 你想确认是否收费、是否包含在内，会怎么问？

choices.text: What is this $20 service charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: What is this $20 service charge?
feedback.explanation: “service charge”指服务费，需与自愿给的小费区分。

choices.text: Is this the late check-out fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this the late check-out fee?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Does this amount include tax?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this amount include tax?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Is the deposit shown anywhere on this bill?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the deposit shown anywhere on this bill?
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。

turns.text: The $20 is the room service delivery charge. Tax is listed separately below.

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店解释账单上的具体费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: And this $30 charge here—what is that for?

feedback.naturalExpression: And this $30 charge here—what is that for?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: So the tax isn’t included in the room rate?

feedback.naturalExpression: So the tax isn’t included in the room rate?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Does this match the rate from my original reservation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this match the rate from my original reservation?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Okay, that makes sense. What about this charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that makes sense. What about this charge?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

turns.text: That’s the late check-out fee you agreed to yesterday.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Right, I remember now. Thanks for explaining.

feedback.naturalExpression: Right, I remember now. Thanks for explaining.
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

choices.text: Okay, that clears it up. Everything looks fine now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that clears it up. Everything looks fine now.
feedback.explanation: “clears it up”表示疑问已经被解释清楚，给对方一个结束澄清的信号。

choices.text: Got it. I’m ready to pay.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’m ready to pay.
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。
